title: Add an explicit ending instruction in your prompt (e.g., make them say bye bye…
content: Add an explicit ending instruction in your prompt (e.g., make them say bye bye at the end) to force a funny closing beat in Seedance 2.0.
tips: Add an explicit ending instruction in your prompt (e.g., make them say bye bye at the end) to force a funny closing beat in Seedance 2.0.

fr.content: Ajoutez une instruction explicite de fin dans votre prompt (par exemple, faites-les dire bye bye à la fin) pour forcer une conclusion humoristique dans Seedance 2.0.
